purpose: Teach: 真っ暗/滅多に/遥か/真夏/呆れ/入り込ん/通り過ぎ/つづき

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、メイ姉さんのお店、停電で真っ暗になったの
lines.en: Sho, the power went out at my shop and it went completely dark.
lines.style: Soft, matter-of-fact opening. Warm tone like sharing something that happened. Pause after his name — comfortable silence. Gentle pace, no alarm.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、滅多に泣かないんだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I hardly ever cry, you know.
lines.style: Quiet statement of fact. Small, genuine pride — not boasting. Eyes meeting hers. Steady voice that doesn't waver.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、遥か昔のおとぎ話、聞きたい?
lines.en: Sho, would you like to hear an old fairytale?
lines.style: Gentle, inviting offer. Soft smile in the voice. Slight lift at the end — genuinely curious if he wants this. The tone of offering something precious without pressure.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、真夏のプール、楽しみだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I'm really looking forward to the pool in summer.
lines.style: Bright, uncomplicated excitement. No performance — just a kid's genuine anticipation. Natural, unguarded rhythm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、ぼくのいたずらに、メイ姉さんも呆れるかな
lines.en: Mei-sis, do you think you'll get annoyed at my pranks?
lines.style: Playful, testing question. Light mischief in the delivery. Watching her face. A little wry — not worried, just curious what she'll say.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お祖父ちゃんちに入り込んで遊んでたよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I've been going over to Grandpa's house and playing there.
lines.style: Casual, offhand memory. Small smile underneath — remembering something he likes. No big deal tone, but the detail matters to him.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが家の前を通り過ぎる時、手を振ってね
lines.en: Sho, when your dad walks past the house, make sure to wave at him, okay?
lines.style: Gentle direction, not demanding. Warm and practical. A small thing that matters. Said like she's looking out for him.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、絵本のつづき、お祖母ちゃんに聞きたい
lines.en: Mei-sis, I want to ask Grandma what happens next in the picture book.
lines.style: Simple, eager request. Open and trusting — naturally assumes the adults around him will help. Soft, genuine voice.
